elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The added language addresses only professional liability and cyber liability insurance; it does not require commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability coverage or per-occurrence limit is stated.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a minimum aggregate limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability coverage or aggregate limit is stated.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Kubient to maintain “professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.”

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The data-processing condition is present because the operative language states that Kubient collects, maintains, manages, or stores visitor data. The added clause requires cyber liability insurance but does not expressly require privacy liability coverage.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber/privacy liability insurance must have a minimum limit of USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although Kubient processes visitor data, the clause requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber liability insurance and does not expressly include privacy liability coverage.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no obligation to provide certificates or other evidence of insurance upon request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Kubient to maintain “professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.”

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies professional liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain cyber liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires Kubient to maintain cyber liability insurance.

elements.element: Cyber liability insurance must have a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the stated fallback limits for E&O and cyber liability insurance. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits CGL, workers' compensation, certificates on request, express privacy liability coverage, and the higher E&O and cyber/privacy limits. The change is otherwise targeted and does not contradict the existing provisions.
